title: Badge White Outline
description: Small outline white badge. Neutral border and dark text on white, fills neutral on hover.

styles.css: &{transition: background-color 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, color 180ms ease; display: inline-block;} &:hover{background-color: var(--wp--preset--color--neutral-200); color: var(--wp--preset--color--contrast); border-color: var(--wp--preset--color--neutral-200);} & a{transition: color 200ms ease;} & a:hover{color: var(--wp--preset--color--contrast); text-decoration: none;} & a:active{color: var(--wp--preset--color--contrast); text-decoration: none;} & a:focus-visible{outline: 2px solid var(--wp--preset--color--focus-background); outline-offset: 2px;}
